timeline.home.description: The name of the home timeline (the posts of the accounts the reader follows), for assistive technology.

timeline.new_posts.description: The button over the top of the home timeline or a list's timeline while new posts wait or went in above the reader; pressing it shows them at the top. count is how many.

timeline.new_posts_missed.description: The button over the home timeline's top when posts may have been missed (after a reconnection); pressing it reads the newest posts again and shows them at the top.

timeline.local.defaultMessage: ローカルタイムライン
timeline.local.description: The name of the local timeline (the public posts of this server's people), for assistive technology.

timeline.federated.description: The name of the federated timeline (the public posts this server knows from every server), for assistive technology.

timeline.tag.description: The name of a hashtag's timeline, for assistive technology. name is the hashtag without #.

timeline.tag_back.description: The button at the top of a hashtag's screen that goes back to where the reader came from.

timeline.tag_follow.description: The button at the end of a hashtag's title that follows it, so that its posts join the reader's home timeline.

timeline.tag_following.description: The button at the end of a hashtag's title while the reader follows it; pressing it stops following.

timeline.tag_follow_failed.defaultMessage: {follow, select, follow {#{name} のフォロー} other {#{name} のフォローの解除}}を完了できませんでした。
timeline.tag_follow_failed.description: The notice at the bottom of the page when following a hashtag, or unfollowing it, got no answer from the server (the network), beside Try again. The button stays as it was. follow is follow or unfollow; name is the hashtag without #.

timeline.tag_empty.defaultMessage: まだ #{name} の投稿はありません。このサーバーに届いた #{name} の投稿がここに表示されます。
timeline.tag_empty.description: In place of a hashtag's posts when it has none. name is the hashtag without #.

timeline.lists.description: The name of the index of the reader's lists, for assistive technology.

timeline.lists_title.description: The title at the top of the index of the reader's lists, beside the list glyph.

timeline.lists_loading.defaultMessage: リストを読み込んでいます…
timeline.lists_loading.description: In place of the reader's lists while they are being fetched.

timeline.lists_failed.defaultMessage: リストを読み込めませんでした。
timeline.lists_failed.description: In place of the reader's lists when fetching them failed; a retry action follows it.

timeline.lists_empty.defaultMessage: まだリストはありません。リストはここに表示され、それぞれのメンバーの投稿を読めます。
timeline.lists_empty.description: In place of the reader's lists when they have made none.

timeline.list_members.description: How many accounts are in a list, under its name in the index and beside its title on its screen.

timeline.list_back.description: The button at the top of a list's screen that goes back to the index of the reader's lists.

timeline.list.description: The name of a list's timeline, for assistive technology. name is the list's name, as the reader wrote it.

timeline.list_loading.defaultMessage: リストを読み込んでいます…
timeline.list_loading.description: In place of a list's screen while the list is being fetched.

timeline.list_failed.defaultMessage: リストを読み込めませんでした。
timeline.list_failed.description: In place of a list's screen when fetching the list failed; Try again follows it.

timeline.list_gone.defaultMessage: このリストはもうありません。
timeline.list_gone.description: In place of a list's screen when the server has no such list: the reader deleted it, on this or another device.

timeline.list_empty.defaultMessage: まだこのリストのメンバーの投稿はありません。メンバーが投稿すると、ここに表示されます。
timeline.list_empty.description: In place of a list's posts when its members have none.

timeline.retry.description: The action after a failure to load the reader's lists, or a list, which fetches it again.

timeline.bookmarks.description: The name of the column of the posts the reader bookmarked, for assistive technology.

timeline.bookmarks_empty.defaultMessage: まだブックマークはありません。ブックマークした投稿がここに表示されます。
timeline.bookmarks_empty.description: In place of the reader's bookmarks when they have none.

timeline.list_new.description: The button of the lists' screen that opens the field to make a list.

timeline.list_name.description: The label of the field of a list's name, when it is made or renamed.

timeline.list_create.description: The button that makes a list of the name written.

timeline.list_cancel.description: The button that closes the field of a list's name without keeping it.

timeline.list_save.description: The button that keeps a list's new name.

timeline.list_more.description: The name, for assistive technology, of the button at the end of a list's title that opens the menu of what may be done with the list (rename it, its members, delete it), and the menu's name; apart from every post's More.

timeline.list_rename.description: The item of a list's menu that changes its name in place.

timeline.list_members_open.description: The item of a list's menu, and the title of its screen, of the accounts in the list.

timeline.list_delete.description: The item of a list's menu that deletes it after a confirmation.

timeline.list_limit.defaultMessage: 作れるリストは 50 個までです。先にどれかのリストを削除してください。
timeline.list_limit.description: When the server refuses a new list because the reader has 50, the most there may be: under the name's field, as its error, while Create is dimmed.

timeline.list_delete_title.defaultMessage: リスト「{name}」を削除しますか？
timeline.list_delete_title.description: The question of the confirmation before deleting a list. name is the list's name.

timeline.list_delete_text.defaultMessage: リストとそのタイムラインは消えますが、メンバーのフォローはそのままです。取り消せません。
timeline.list_delete_text.description: What deleting a list does, in its confirmation.

timeline.list_delete_confirm.description: The button of the confirmation that deletes the list.

timeline.list_add.defaultMessage: フォロー中のアカウントを追加
timeline.list_add.description: The label of the field on a list's members that finds an account the reader follows by its name or handle.

timeline.list_add_button.description: The button of an account found on a list's members that puts it in the list.

timeline.list_added.description: In place of Add, for an account found that is in the list already.

timeline.list_remove.description: The button of a member of a list that takes it out of the list.

timeline.list_remove_member.description: The name, for assistive technology, of the button of a member of a list that takes it out of the list; it holds the button's visible word (timeline.list_remove). name is the member's display name.

timeline.list_members_empty.defaultMessage: このリストにはまだ誰もいません。フォロー中のアカウントを追加すると、その投稿をここで読めます。
timeline.list_members_empty.description: In place of a list's members when it has none.

timeline.list_members_limit.defaultMessage: リストのメンバーは 1000 人までです。先にどれかのメンバーを外してください。
timeline.list_members_limit.description: When the server refuses to add an account to a list that has 1,000 members, the most there may be: under the field that finds accounts, as its error, while Add is dimmed.

timeline.list_write_failed.defaultMessage: 保存できませんでした。もう一度試してください。
timeline.list_write_failed.description: When making, renaming or deleting a list, or putting an account in it or taking one out, got no answer from the server (the network): under the field of the name or of the accounts found, or at the bottom of the page.
